title: Uniform negative normalized character values for nontrivial irreducible representations of each connected compact Lie group
author: Skip Garibaldi; Robert M. Guralnick; Eric M. Rains
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique—Mathématiques 12(2025),1229–1287; published2025-08-25; DOI10.5802/jep.310
difficulty_reason: Beyond the ordinary Weyl character and dimension formulas, the proof extends an alternating character kernel holomorphically across reflection walls and identifies limiting characters even on chamber boundaries. It establishes weighted Gaussian orthogonality and derives negativity of every nonzero limiting kernel. Highest-weight compactness and reductions through the center and simple factors then produce a uniform group-dependent bound across all nontrivial irreducible characters, beyond ordinary doctoral representation-theory qualifiers.
